highlights.title: Store your configuration files centrally
highlights.body: Move your infrastructure configuration to Confluence with ease and feed your templates with variables for your different systems.
highlights.explanation: Provide different configurations based on one template. Feed your template with variables ${nom.nom.nom} in the content. When the macro is rendered the variables will be replaced by the defined values.

highlights.title: Loved by humans and robots
highlights.body: Download your code in different settings. Highlight your code with syntax-highlighting and different themes and discover more features like copy to clipboard.
highlights.explanation: The Download Feature provides you different options to directly download your configuration in the setting you need. An administrator can also download configs directly from Confluence with e.g. curl via HTTP REST API.

highlights.title: Remote templates supported via http
highlights.body: Store your templates where you want and load them from any source as long as they are accessible via http. Basic Auth and https supported.
highlights.explanation: Store your templates where you want, for example GitHub, Bitbucket or your private Webserver. You can load your remote templates from any source as long as they are accessible via http. Basic Auth and https supported.

  • copy to clipboard
  • Read-only mode supported

  • Dark theme

  • Your data stays within your Confluence instance.

highlights.explanation: Provide different configurations based on one template. Feed your template with variables ${nom.nom.nom} in the content. When the macro is rendered the variables will be replaced by the defined values.

highlights.title: Loved by humans and robots
highlights.body: Download your code in different settings. Highlight your code with syntax-highlighting and different themes and discover more features like copy to clipboard.
highlights.explanation: The Download Feature provides you different options to directly download your configuration in the setting you need. Works in modern browsers (javascript).

highlights.title: Remote templates supported via http
highlights.body: Store your templates where you want and load them from any source as long as they are accessible via http. Basic Auth and https supported.
highlights.explanation: Store your templates where you want, for example GitHub, Bitbucket or your private Webserver. You can load your remote templates from any source as long as they are accessible via http. Basic Auth and https supported.

text.moreDetails:

Use the Advanced Codeblocks Single for:

  • inserting single code-snippet on a page without variable replacements.

Use the Advanced Codeblocks Multi for:

  • inserting the config-block and template with variable replacements on a page.

Use the Advanced Codeblocks Multi Remote for:

  • [AC-32] Remove deprecated download servlets (Breaking Change)

Breaking Changes

  • There are several breaking changes regarding the REST API - summarized:
    • All Endpoints: GET /rest/advancedcodeblocks/1/*
      • URL param pageId is now contentId
    • XML/JSON List Endpoint: GET /rest/advancedcodeblocks/1/download_list/*
      • page is now content
    • Download block Endpoint: GET /rest/advancedcodeblocks/1/download_code/plain_text
      • Removed newline on start of downloaded file
      • Hidden chars are not removed anymore
    • Removed deprecated Servlets: GET /plugins/servlet/advanced-codeblock-macro-*

    See the 4.0.0 REST API documentation for all details.

highlights.explanation: The Download Feature provides you different options to directly download your configuration in the setting you need. An administrator can also download configs directly from Confluence with e.g. curl via HTTP REST API.

highlights.title: Remote templates supported via http
highlights.body: Store your templates where you want and load them from any source as long as they are accessible via http. Basic Auth and https supported.
highlights.explanation: Store your templates where you want, for example GitHub, Bitbucket or your private Webserver. You can load your remote templates from any source as long as they are accessible via http. Basic Auth and https supported.

---

Use the Advanced Codeblocks Single for:

  • inserting single code-snippet on a page without variable replacements.

Use the Advanced Codeblock s Multi for:

  • inserting the config-block and template with variable replacements on a page.

Use the Advanced Codeblocks Multi Remote for:

  • inserting the config-block with variable replacements on a page but your template from any source like GitHub, Bitbucket or your private Webserver.

The common features are:

  • expand or collapse the codeblocks you want to see or not
  • Get what you need! Use the Download Feature to:
    • Show or hide download links
    • Download via secure HTTP REST API
  • Color your code with syntax-highlighting
    • more than 150 programming languages
    • Automatic language detection supported
    • Detected language displayed
  • Choose your style out of four themes
  • copy to clipboard
  • Data Center approved and Read-only mode supported
  • Respects the Allowlist
